title: OpenVINO JS API tests fail downloading test model from raw.githubusercontent.com (30s timeout)

failed_jobs.name: OpenVINO JS API (24) / OpenVINO JS API
failed_jobs.symptom: tests/setup.js failed to download test_model_fp32.xml from raw.githubusercontent.com, causing an unhandled promise rejection and exit code 1

key_errors: Downloading file by link: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openvinotoolkit/testdata/master/models/test_model/test_model_fp32.xml to /__w/openvino/openvino/src/bindings/js/node/tests/unit/test_models with filename: test_model_fp32.xml
Failed to download the model: Request was timed out after 30000 ms..

UnhandledPromiseRejection: This error originated either by throwing inside of an async function without a catch block, or by rejecting a promise which was not handled with .catch(). The promise rejected with the reason "Request was timed out after 30000 ms.".
root_cause: The JS API test setup script (src/bindings/js/node/tests/setup.js) downloads test model files from raw.githubusercontent.com at test time. This request exceeded the hardcoded 30-second timeout, most likely due to transient GitHub raw-content CDN latency/throttling rather than any change in this commit (which only touches an unrelated notification script). Because the download promise's rejection is not wrapped in a try/catch (or .catch handler), Node.js treats it as an unhandled promise rejection and crashes the whole test run with exit code 1 instead of retrying or failing just the affected test.
reproduction_steps: cd src/bindings/js/node && npm run test_setup (repeatedly, or with a throttled/blocked network route to raw.githubusercontent.com) to reproduce the timeout; the crash itself can be reproduced with any rejected download promise since tests/setup.js has no retry/catch logic.
recommended_actions: Wrap the model download call in tests/setup.js in a try/catch (or add a .catch handler) so a failed download produces a clear test failure instead of an unhandled promise rejection crash.
Add retry logic (e.g., 2-3 attempts with backoff) around the raw.githubusercontent.com download in tests/setup.js, since CDN timeouts are expected to be transient.
Consider increasing the 30000 ms timeout or caching the test model artifact (e.g., via actions/cache) to avoid depending on live network access to GitHub's raw content CDN on every run.
Re-run the OpenVINO JS API workflow; no code fix is required to unblock master given this is an unrelated-commit transient network failure.
prevention_strategies: Add network-call resiliency (timeout + retry + explicit error handling) to any CI step that downloads external resources at test time, and prefer committing/caching small fixed test assets instead of fetching them from a remote CDN on every run.
historical_context: This is the first recorded occurrence of this specific signature (raw.githubusercontent.com testdata download timeout in the JS API test setup). Other Network-category patterns in the database cover different external dependencies (apt mirrors, HuggingFace Hub, artifact upload, DNS resolution), confirming this is a distinct, isolated external-service timeout rather than a recurring known issue.
